description: Ask CodeRifts before Write/Edit of a contract artifact; deny a Bash command that names one with a write shape; match REPL and read tool_input.code as text. Host timeout is 8s (seconds). Gate budget is 5000ms. The PreToolUse command sets "onFailure": "block", so a host timeout, an exit other than 0 or 2, and a missing executable block the tool call. Exit 2 remains the gate's own rejection.
